description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_ChildDef_Table, which specifies the validation and processing logic for table child elements within the HTML Purifier library. It handles the structure and validation of table elements such as 'tr', 'tbody', 'thead', 'tfoot', 'caption', 'colgroup', and 'col' during HTML sanitization.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ChildDef_Table
classes.description: Class representing the child element definitions and validation logic for HTML table elements, ensuring correct nesting and structure in sanitized HTML.

methods.name: validateChildren
methods.description: Validates and processes the child tokens of a table element to ensure proper structure, collecting and categorizing table components like captions, rows, and columns.
